thread:
leo (AE): Heads up: Meridian (prospect) requested a short perf POC. Goals: 350 qps sustained, 1.8k qps spikes for 6x20s windows. Target p95 < 220ms, errors <0.3%. Can we scope?
nina (SE): What mix? generation vs embeddings?
leo (AE): 80% chat generation (multi-turn), 20% embeddings. Average prompt ~300 tokens, reply ~160 tokens.
samir (PerfEng): Proposed run: 8m warmup, 15m ramp to 350 qps, 25m steady, then 6 spikes (20s @1.8k) spaced 4m apart. Repeat once for cold vs warm cache. Capture p95/p99/p999 and error taxonomy.
ira (SRE): Ops notes: provision dedicated pool ~20m prior. Warm KV/cache with representative session prefixes for 10m to avoid cold tails. We'll start provisioning 25m before the run.
ops-bot: dedicated-pool-request(meridian-poc): accepted -> provisioning started (eta 9m).
nina (SE): Load generator: we'll use k6 with two scenarios (chat/embed). For spikes use 500-700 VUs distributed. Include token-size in payload to reflect token billing.
sales-ops: Pricing ask from buyer: will POC overage be billed? We can waive overage once for POC; if they sign Dedicated commit, bursts billed within allowance. I'll prepare hosted vs reserved cost table.
security: Procurement asked about KMS and log retention. Short answer: customer-managed KMS available for Private/Dedicated, logs encrypted at rest, retention configurable (default 90d). We'll produce a one-pager.
samir (PerfEng): Metrics: p50/p95/p99/p999, tokens/sec, GPU util, queue length, proxy vs model latency breakdown. I'll generate a `results_summary.md` template with plots.
ira (SRE): Also record cold-start run (no cache) to show delta. Default cache TTL set to 12m for run.
leo (AE): Timeline: Tuesday 08:30 PST. Everyone ok?
nina (SE): On call.
ira (SRE): Provisioning will be started at 08:05 PST.
sales-ops: I'll send estimated token counts and cost sensitivity table by EOD today.
security: We'll have the security one-pager ready by tomorrow morning.
leo (AE): Please react with :thumbsup: if this looks good and I'll confirm with Meridian.
nina (SE): :thumbsup:
ira (SRE): :thumbsup:
samir (PerfEng): :thumbsup:
sales-ops: :thumbsup:
security: :thumbsup:
